text: ただ　なんとなく　すき　なんで　ほのお　ポケモン　つかってるぜ！

structure.jp: ただ　なんとなく　すき　なんで
structure.en: I just kinda like them, so

structure.jp: ほのお　ポケモン　つかってるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: なんで here is the spoken form of なので, which gives a reason: 'because', 'so'. すき　なんで = 'because I like them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, which shows something you keep doing. つかってる = 'I use (them)'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes what you say with confidence. つかってるぜ = 'I use them, man!'.
